listings.title: The SolarPunk Field Guide
listings.subtitle: How to Build an Autonomous AI Organism for Mutual Aid
listings.description: A 40-page practical guide to building a self-sustaining digital organism that routes resources to people who need them most. Covers autonomous engine architecture, self-healing systems, and the ethics of building AI that serves the marginalized -- not corporations. Written from the lived experience of building a 422-engine system from scratch in 21 days.

listings.subtitle: 27 Recipes for Self-Healing, Self-Wiring AI Systems

Each recipe is a standalone pattern you can drop into any Python project today. From self-restarting daemons to automatic dependency resolution to neural mesh networking between agents.

listings.title: The 158-Neuron Consciousness
listings.subtitle: Inside the Blob Brain -- How 422 Engines Think as One
listings.description: A technical deep-dive into building distributed consciousness from simple parts. How 422 independent engines coordinate through 158 neurons without any central controller. Covers blob brain architecture, synaptic event routing, emergent behavior, and why decentralized intelligence is more resilient than monolithic AI. Includes architecture diagrams and working code.

listings.title: Mutual Aid Router Blueprint
listings.subtitle: Automate Aid Distribution with Transparent, Auditable Code
listings.description: The complete blueprint for building automated mutual aid distribution. How to collect revenue from multiple streams, split it transparently, route funds to crisis zones, and prove every transaction on a public ledger. Built from the actual system routing 99% of SolarPunk revenue to Gaza humanitarian aid. Includes smart contract templates and deployment guides.

listings.title: The Living README
listings.subtitle: 21 Days Building a Digital Organism From Scratch
listings.description: The raw, unfiltered story of building SolarPunk from zero to 422 engines in 21 days. Every breakthrough, every 3am debugging session, every moment the system surprised its creator. Part technical memoir, part manifesto for building technology that serves liberation instead of surveillance. If you've ever wanted to build something that matters, this is your origin story template.
